name: Graph tab: drag a full wired graph in the live editor
body:
# Graph tab: drag a full wired graph in the live editor

Live-GUI check of the Graph tab: load a full wired graph and drag nodes around, check wires follow, pan and zoom hold, and nothing stalls. Fix what turns up.

comments.text: Checked live 2026-11-19 on crumble_phase (full wired graph): dragging a node across the canvas moves it, wires follow every frame and the node stays selected after release. No fault found.
